title: Lepton $g-2$ non-universality of hadronic contributions and a sub-GeV window to New Physics
summary: We propose the linear combination of the anomalous magnetic moments of the muon and electron, $a_{μ-e} \equiv a_μ- (m_μ/m_e)^2 a_e$, as a natural low-energy window quantity that may directly probe the current discrepancy between the data-driven and lattice-QCD evaluations of hadronic contributions. The rescaling ensures an exact cancellation of the short-range effects, thereby improving the UV behavior and bypassing a number of issues that arise in $a_μ$ or $a_e$ separately.
